summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed from padded slices; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rewritten with patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates and worker partitioning; PatchDataset docstring float fix; math import removed), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_len). Open items: tests are unverified because I was asked not to run code; setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(1234); the pinned values at 1e-5 relative tolerance on 4-decimal literals may fail on rounding; the docstring example outputs were derived by hand. Three pre-existing lines over 120 characters in get_valid_patch_size were left untouched.
